title: Civic Notice: The Missing Wednesday
description: A flat automated Snazzie FM Civic Notification System bulletin reporting the removal of Wednesday from the regional calendar as a routine scheduling adjustment.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System. <p:0.5> Please remain seated for the duration of this notice.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Wednesday has been removed from the regional calendar. <p:0.5> Do not attempt to schedule within it.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: If you woke this morning and the day felt thin, this is expected. <p:0.3> Please plan around the hours that are no longer there.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Should you recall a Wednesday, report the memory at your nearest D M V kiosk. <p:0.5> Do not discuss it with others.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: <p:0.5> This concludes the test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System. <p:0.5> This was Wednesday. There will not be another.
